headline: J.J. McCarthy Trade Fallout: Dart, Winston, Harbaugh, Giants, Vikings
summary: Yesterday, the Giants made the first big in-season trade of the still young 2026 season, acquiring former Vikings 10th overall pick J.J. McCarthy in exchange for a fifth-round pick in the upcoming draft. Now that the dust has begun to settle, it’s starting to become clear just how much things have changed in the fallout […]

headline: Greg Rousseau is first player since 1998 with 2+ sacks in first three games of a season
summary: While Bills quarterback Josh Allen is the leading candidate to be league MVP, his teammate linebacker Greg Rousseau is making an early case for Defensive Player of the Year.

headline: Through three games, Brock Purdy still hasn't been sacked
summary: The 49ers are the fourth team since 1990 to allow zero sacks in their first three games.

headline: Cowboys' Schottenheimer 'aligned' with Jones after Rio gaffes
summary: Cowboys coach Brian Schottenheimer said he would "be better" after meeting with Jerry Jones about questionable late-game coaching decisions in Sunday's loss to the Ravens.

headline: Can the 0-3 Texans defy history again to make playoffs?
summary: Houston became the first team in the common playoff format to make the postseason after starting 0-3 in 2025.

headline: Ravens-Cowboys in Brazil averaged record 24.9M viewers
summary: The Ravens' 34-31 victory over the Cowboys in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, averaged 24.9 million viewers on CBS on Sunday, making it the most-watched NFL international game in history.
